note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #23, Q2 2024 Conflicts) keeps INEGI columns bp2_1..bp2_4_11 from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0624.csv (imported lowercased) and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step). mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's own Q2 data dictionary labels each BP2_* column (e.g. BP2_2_16 'Conflictos o enfrentamientos: Grafiti o pintas a su casa por alguien que usted identifique'; BP2_3_4 'Incidentes o problemas con desconocidos(as) en la calle'; BP2_4_09 'Tipo de consecuencias derivadas de conflictos: Dialogo o platica'); 37/37 labels agree in content with the Q2 questionnaire option carrying the same code number. Q2 vs Q1 source check (done, not assumed): the Q2 dictionary has the same 37 BP2_* variables as Q1 with identical labels except BP2_4_05, whose Q2 label adds '(palos, varillas, tubos, etc.)' (Q1's lacked it; the printed option has it in both); all 37 bp2_* catalogos are byte-identical to Q1's. Every one of the 38 distinct Spanish strings shipped (CP2 intro, 2.1 stem, 2.2/2.3/2.4 stems, 18+7+11 options) is found in the Q2 PDF's text layer after whitespace normalisation (only '...producto/ servicio...' needed its line wrap joined), and 150-dpi renders of pp.3-4 were read to confirm; the Q2 Section II wording is identical to Q1's, so the shipped text fields equal batch_672's except table/section_id/instrument (instrument says 'segundo trimestre'). Unlike Q1, the Q2 PDF's text layer does carry the bold stems, so no string here rests on a page render alone. Cross-check (route 9 style): all 37 live item vectors reproduce the raw INEGI Q2 2024 CSV cell for cell after the .do's recodes (74/74 item x level counts, e.g. bp2_1 1/2 = 9587/14519, bp2_2_16 0/1 = 8866/721, bp2_2_18 0/1 = 8251/1336, bp2_4_09 0/1 = 3848/4403); raw has 24114 rows, 8 bp2_1=9 set missing by the .do -> 24106 live ids; 20 respondents' bp2_3_*=9 set missing on all 7 bp2_3 items. Words: item_text / section_prompt / instructions are the administered questionnaire wording (text_source=study_materials), not the terser dictionary labels. Kept as printed: 2.2 stem's typo 'familares' (sic; 2.1 and CP2 spell 'familiares'), '(as)' gender fills, trailing '?' on 2.2 options and the stem's trailing '...'. Normalised: CP2 line-break hyphen 'trabajo/es-cuela' joined; line wraps joined with a space. Stripped: question numbers, option codes, dot leaders, 'ESPECIFIQUE' blanks after Otro, interviewer directions (MUESTRE LA TARJETA 'B' Y CIRCULE UN SOLO CODIGO / LOS CODIGOS CORRESPONDIENTES; CIRCULE LOS CODIGOS CORRESPONDIENTES; PASE A LA SECCION III; SI SE REGISTRO CODIGO 18 'NINGUNO', PASE A LA SECCION III). Structure (same as batch_672): section _1 = 2.1 screener (stem in item_text), _2 = 2.2 (stem in section_prompt, option wording in item_text), _3 = 2.3, _4 = 2.4; instructions = CP2 read-aloud introduction. Options: bp2_1 1=Si, 2=No (questionnaire and catalogo; 9 'No sabe / no responde' set missing by the .do, no row). The 36 checklist items are 0/1 flags; option_text is INEGI's catalogo value label ('0' = 'No se declaro como opcion afirmativa', '1' = 'Si', identical in all 36), not questionnaire print. Every level each item's respondents used has an option row. Routing (not a defect): 2.2 asked only if 2.1=Si (n=9587 = bp2_1 Si count); 2.3/2.4 skipped when 2.2 code 18 'Ninguno' was circled (8251 = 9587 - 1336; bp2_3 n=8231 after the 20 code-9 respondents). Step 3b: live items match this question block exactly (37 = 1 + 18 + 7 + 11); dictionary Description ('Q2 2024') is accurate, but the dictionary Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while data and wording are the 2024 Q2 (junio 2024, file suffix 0624) wave -- same defect as the Q1 siblings. Minor INEGI-side oddity, no effect here: the Q2 dictionary's PER range reads '0224' (Q1's reads '0124'). English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation), reused verbatim from batch_672 since the Spanish is identical; INEGI publishes no English questionnaire.
public_note: Fuente: INEGI, Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU) 2024, segundo trimestre -- IRW transcribed Section II (questions 2.1-2.4) from INEGI's questionnaire, stripped interviewer directions, used INEGI's data-catalogue labels for the 0/1 checklist codes, and added an English translation of its own; INEGI does not endorse this item text.
